item.title: fix: scale Gateway RSS diagnostics to runtime limits (#124914)
item.summary: fix: scale Gateway RSS diagnostics to runtime limits (#124914) * fix(logging): scale RSS pressure to runtime limits Derive Gateway RSS warning and critical thresholds from the smaller of the effective V8 heap and OS process limit. This preserves heap and rapid-growth pressure detection while avoiding routine false alerts on large heaps. * test(logging): narrow optional heap fixture * fix(logging): bound process memory sentinels * test(logging): pin Bun physical memory fixture
